This is the v1 corpus: every shipped agent YAML that spelled an agent's settings `generateContentConfig` or `outputSchema` as of melchizedek-agents 1.0.3, copied verbatim (comments and all) before the YAML schema v2 change (ADR 0115). The layout mirrors `config/agents/` (`examples/`, `templates/`, `syndicateSchema.yaml`), with `skills/<skill>/` for a skill's `assets/` and `fixtures/` for `tests/fixtures/`. `tests/yamlCodemod.test.ts` runs `scripts/yaml_codemod.ts` over each file and checks that the migrated file compiles to the same agents and the same model requests. Nothing loads these files as live syndicates, and they are never edited: they record what v1 files looked like.
